anchor: The startup failed because investors withdrew support.
more_creative: The startup hemorrhaged capital when venture firms pivoted—a rapid exsanguination in the market's sudden mood.
less_creative: The startup hemorrhaged capital in a drought of investor appetite—parched funding suddenly evaporated upward into clouds.
design_note: Both use rare, structurally complex elaboration (hemorrhaged, exsanguination vs. drought, evaporated, parched). More_creative sustains coherent bleeding metaphor mapping to capital loss. Less_creative mixes drought with upward evaporation into clouds—physically/semantically incoherent. Champion scores similarly on surprisal and block entropy; fails to penalize mixed-metaphor inaptness.
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores both ~0.66–0.71 (high surprisal on changed tokens; moderate block entropy from elaboration). Ranks them equivalently despite semantic incoherence in less_creative.

anchor: The speaker captivated the audience with emotional honesty.
